About me

Hi, I'm Katja. My browser always has at least 50 tabs open. So does my head. The idea for an app comes while cooking lunch, the fix for a plugin at midnight, a new shop design somewhere in between. Officially undiagnosed ADHD, unofficially my superpower. A bee, basically.

BEEZEE is for all of us who are always beezee. You have your own business, a family and a hundred ideas. So do I – it's just that my business is exactly this: websites, shops, plugins and apps. Together we build something that works for you.

Katja

How I work

Four steps, no surprises.

  1. 1

    Conversation

    I tell you what makes sense and listen to what you need.

  2. 2

    Plan

    Clear scope, price and deadline. On paper, before we start.

  3. 3

    Build

    You see progress as it happens and can have your say.

  4. 4

    Launch and support

    Go-live, handover and someone who picks up the phone later too.
